description:
[Broker Sync API] Real positions across all of a user's connected brokerages, one normalized schema, stamped as_of.

Use when you want a user's real positions across all connected brokerages in one schema. Not for cash and buying power (use broker_sync_balances).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: broker_sync_positions
